title: Exploring the binding mode of BBA protein anchored on defective graphene and evaluating the biocompatibility of two types of graphene with lambda-repressor protein.
authors: Han, Lu; Zhang, Xiaoyun; Wu, Fei; Wang, Tianhua; Zhai, Honglin
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究BBA蛋白和lambda阻遏蛋白与缺陷石墨烯的结合模式及生物相容性，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作相关蛋白（lambda-repressor）但核心是蛋白-纳米材料界面，非TF-DNA结合体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Since defects in nanomaterials are inevitable during experimental manipulation, investigating the interactions between defective materials and active biological proteins is crucial for evaluating the biocompatibility and biosafety of nanomaterials. This study employs molecular dynamics simulation techniques to investigate the interaction mechanisms between two types of graphene (ideal graphene and defective graphene) and two model proteins (BBA protein and lambda-repressor protein). The simulation results indicate that both types of graphene exhibit superior biocompatibility with the lambda-repressor protein compared to the BBA protein. The difference in binding modes of the BBA protein with the two graphenes arises mainly from its initial orientation. Notably, the positively charged Arg residue forces the BBA protein to "anchor" to the surface of defective graphene, significantly restricting its lateral migration. The lambda-repressor protein is "anchored" onto the surface of defective graphene through hydrogen bonding interactions involving its Ser residue. Such hydrogen bonding was never reported in similar systems. The distinctive binding modes of these two model proteins with defective graphene are beneficial for the future development of safer and more efficient nanomedicine technologies.
abstract_zh: 由于纳米材料在实验操作过程中缺陷不可避免，研究缺陷材料与活性生物蛋白之间的相互作用对于评估纳米材料的生物相容性和生物安全性至关重要。本研究采用分子动力学模拟技术，探讨了两种石墨烯（理想石墨烯和缺陷石墨烯）与两种模型蛋白（BBA蛋白和λ抑制子蛋白）之间的相互作用机制。模拟结果表明，两种石墨烯与λ抑制子蛋白的生物相容性均优于BBA蛋白。BBA蛋白与两种石墨烯结合模式的差异主要源于其初始取向。值得注意的是，带正电的Arg残基迫使BBA蛋白“锚定”在缺陷石墨烯表面，显著限制了其横向迁移。λ抑制子蛋白通过其Ser残基的氢键相互作用“锚定”在缺陷石墨烯表面，这种氢键在类似系统中从未被报道过。这两种模型蛋白与缺陷石墨烯的独特结合模式，有利于未来开发更安全、更高效的纳米医学技术。
